reason: Integrates Longbridge OpenAPI for Hong Kong and US market data, brokerage account and position access, and approval-gated order placement and cancellation; human review is appropriate because it can perform financial trading actions and handle brokerage credentials.

summaries.zh: 接入长桥 OpenAPI，提供港美股行情、账户与持仓查询，以及经审批确认的下单和撤单工具，并配有凭据与功能开关设置页。
summaries.en: Connects to the Longbridge OpenAPI to provide Hong Kong and US market data, account and position queries, and approval-gated order placement and cancellation with configurable credentials and feature settings.

capabilities: Connects to the Longbridge OpenAPI using App Key, App Secret, and Access Token credentials
Retrieves Hong Kong and US market quotes, candlesticks, indices, watchlists, and market status
Reads account summaries and positions when enabled
Places and cancels orders when enabled, with an approval step for each trade action
Provides a settings panel and optional right-side market data panel
